newsitem.title: CHINA: Bank of Montreal to open Beijing branch.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Montreal to open Beijing branch.

text.p: The Bank of Montreal will open a branch in Beijing next year, becoming the first Canadian bank to do so, the China Daily said on Monday, quoting bank chairman Matthew Barrett.
"It is imperative for any bank that wants to offer its customers an opportunity to do business globally to have a strong presence in China," Barrett was quoted as saying.
The Beijing branch was expected to open in April 1997 and would employ about 25 people initially, including 20 local staff, the newspaper said.

The bank would invest $12.3 million of capital in the branch, which would provide trade finance, treasury and project finance services to North American businesses, said Roger Heng, general manager of the Beijing branch.
China has given eight overseas banks permission to operate in the Chinese capital, the newspaper said. Many more foreign banks have applied.
The Bank of Montreal opened a branch in the southern Chinese city of Guangzhou in 1995.
